name: Vitiris

attributes.attribute: honored by many inscriptions in northern England
depicted at times with a pig or a serpent

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Vitiris, also written Vitris, Venus, or Hvitiris, is a British god. Many inscriptions to him surfaced in northern England. The finds hint that he drew followers from beyond the Celtic world as well as within it. No source states what he represented, yet some images show him with a swine or a snake

okr.objective: Present Vitiris as a British god known mostly from northern England inscriptions.
key_results: Many inscriptions to Vitiris come from northern England.
His worshippers came from inside and outside the Celtic world.
Images sometimes show him with a pig or a serpent.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
